subcategoryHints.Cleaning Supplies: Cleaning products, including those bought in a supermarket.

subcategoryHints.Cafés & Snacks: Cafés, bakeries with tables, snack bars, food trucks, fast food.
subcategoryHints.Groceries: Supermarket items and take-away bakery purchases.

subcategoryHints.Taxi & Rideshare: Taxi or ride-hailing rides inside the home city only, and never to or from an airport. Every other taxi or ride-hailing ride is Travel › Vehicle.

subcategoryHints.Hygiene & Beauty: Toiletries, including those bought in a supermarket.

subcategoryHints.Bars & Restaurants: Bars, restaurants, pubs, breweries, wine bars, taverns, bistros (consumed on the premises).
subcategoryHints.Alcoholic Drinks: Alcohol bought to take away (supermarkets, wine shops, liquor stores).

categories.name: Travel
categories.hint: Spending on a trip that fits a Travel subcategory: transport, accommodation, food and drink, activities and vehicle. Other purchases made on a trip keep their normal category.

subcategoryHints.Transport Tickets: Flights, intercity trains and buses, ferries.
subcategoryHints.Travel Groceries: Supermarkets and take-away bakery purchases only.
subcategoryHints.Cafés & Snacks: Cafés, bakeries with tables, snack bars, food trucks, fast food while travelling.
subcategoryHints.Bars & Restaurants: Bars, restaurants, pubs, breweries, wine bars while travelling.
subcategoryHints.Alcoholic Drinks: Bottles bought to take away while travelling.
subcategoryHints.Vehicle: Car rental, fuel, tolls, parking, fines, and taxi or ride-hailing (Uber, Cabify, Bolt, FreeNow) rides.

subcategoryHints.Unclassified: Use only when nothing else fits.

categories.name: Work
categories.hint: Work-related spending: coworking, office supplies and printing.

subcategoryHints.Coworking: Coworking space rent and day passes.
subcategoryHints.Office Supplies: Pens, paper, notebooks, printing, photocopies and other stationery for work.

subcategoryHints.Courses: Language and other courses, classes and tuition.
